$comment: Instagram comment-to-DM automation for LIBERTY DRIVE. Tool-agnostic: paste the message bodies into ManyChat/Chatfuel, or feed this straight to the Instagram Messaging API. Edit `links` ONLY — every message references them.

trigger.$comment: catchAll: also DM people who comment anything else. Turn off if you only want exact keyword matches.

publicCommentReply.$comment: Reply publicly too — comment replies are a strong ranking signal in the first hour. Rotate so it never looks botted.
variants: Sent! Let me know what you think 🚗

flow.text:
Quick controls so you're not lost 🕹️

WASD — move
Shift — sprint
Shift+Space — BOOST
F — steal any car
Left click — shoot
G — graphics quality

Tip: press G if it runs slow on your machine.

That's it — go cause some chaos 🚗💨

If you make something with it, tag me and I'll share it.

branch_how.text:
I described what I wanted and Claude Code wrote it — the city generator, car physics, police AI, weather system, all of it.

Biggest lesson: be specific. "Make it look better" got me nothing. "The car is 2.4x too short for a real sedan at this scale" got me an actual fix.

compliance.$comment: Meta rules that actually bite. Read before going live.
notes: A comment opens a 24-hour window to DM that user. Send inside it — automation tools handle this, but a delayed manual send will fail.
The Instagram account must be a Business or Creator account, connected to a Facebook Page.
Do not send more than one flow per user per post — repeat sends get you rate-limited or flagged as spam.
Keep the public comment replies varied. Identical replies on every comment is the fastest way to look botted.
